tier_reason: Stays C (first-party notebook). Enricher caveat correction: competitor models scored on features shifted by one (1-based libsvm training vs zero-based X_test), outputs unchecked; timing asymmetries in input handling and threads.

corrections.caveats: First-party prediction notebook (184 ms vs XGBoost 4.89 s and LightGBM 11.1 s) with no CPU model, compiler or library versions. The competitor models were trained on 1-based libsvm features (XGBoost.model num_feature 2001 never splits feature 0; LightGBM max_feature_idx=2000, Column_0 'none') while X_test has 2000 zero-based columns, so XGBoost and LightGBM were scored on features shifted by one and their outputs were never checked; CatBoost's features 0-1999 are aligned. Model shapes do not explain the 27x (XGBoost depth at most 6, mean 44.4 leaves vs CatBoost's symmetric 64 over the first 8000 trees; LightGBM mean leaf depth 8.2). The XGBoost DMatrix is built outside the timed cell, so only the LightGBM timing includes input handling, and the LightGBM thread count is never set. Training is slower than XGBoost and LightGBM on letters, airline and szilard/GBM-perf.
